title: Renewal policy transition
preconditions: an existing protected session has an independently selected policy and retained temporal high-water
the requested profile or policy transition lacks proven non-weakening authorization
steps: Request same-session renewal under a numerically higher policy with weaker or unproven assurance. Attempt client repair after continuity/high-water loss.
reject the unproven transition without treating numeric version as assurance; in a separate continuity-loss branch require new initial establishment
a gap in an otherwise valid increasing sequence is not itself continuity loss
invariants: M1-015 R09: Allowed policy/profile transition proves non-weakening and same epoch/high-water; retain existing valid temporal-profile-transition semantics
M1-015 R10: Higher policy version alone, weaker assurance or absent transition authorization cannot authorize same-session migration
M1-015 R11: Restart, lost high-water, epoch/sequence rollback and interval overlap terminate; sequence gaps alone do not
residual_risk: Publisher approval and continuity proofs require later trusted mechanisms.
